Yash's film 'Toxic' releases 'Ladies & Ladies' teaser highlighting female cast

The makers of the upcoming film 'Toxic: A Fairy Tale for Grown-Ups' have released a teaser titled 'Ladies & Ladies'. The teaser introduces the film's prominent female cast, including Nayanthara, Tara Sutaria, Huma Qureshi, and Kiara Advani, alongside lead actor Yash. The release has generated buzz around the film's portrayal of its female characters and its action-drama genre.
